Completed

## Summary
Reviewed the architecture draft for **TetrisGame** as a **Blazor WebAssembly PWA**. The design is approved with mandatory implementation constraints: keep UI thin, keep game rules in domain/application services, use IndexedDB only for last-max-score persistence, and preserve a visible game workflow for runtime proof.

## Evidence
- Reviewed the classification artifact and draft architecture artifact.
- Wrote the review findings artifact at `artifacts/process-runs/8476b73f-6ab3-4e0b-be97-dc501dbfc71e/steps/review-architecture-design.md`.

## Recommendation
Go to implementation with the stated constraints."}
